description:
At Mud Organics, we believe in harnessing the power of nature to bring you premium, all-natural skincare and wellness products. Based in Australia, we’re committed to creating cruelty-free, eco-conscious solutions that promote holistic health and well-being. Each of our products is carefully formulated using ethically sourced, organic ingredients, inspired by the healing power of nature to nurture both body and mind.
Mud Organics' Sea Buckthorn Serum is a deeply nourishing, antioxidant-rich formula infused with Omega 7 to hydrate, restore elasticity, and brighten the skin. Perfect for all skin types, this lightweight serum targets dryness, fine lines, and dullness, leaving your skin rejuvenated, soft, and radiant with regular use. Free from harsh chemicals, it supports natural skin regeneration for a youthful, glowing complexion.
Mud Organics' Gut Repair Supplement is designed to cleanse, restore, and balance your digestive system. Formulated with natural ingredients to reduce bloating and flush out toxins, this supplement supports gut health, aids digestion, and promotes overall well-being. It's your go-to solution for a healthier, lighter feeling and improved digestion, naturally maintaining gut microbiome balance.
Mud Organics’ Sea Buckthorn Serum is uniquely formulated with the highest concentration of Omega 7 on the market, delivering superior hydration and promoting mucous production. Our serum stands out with its natural healing properties, helping to rejuvenate skin, soothe irritations, and combat signs of aging. Clinically proven and 100% vegan, our product offers visible results while remaining gentle on your skin.
We offer a secure payment options which is PayPal. Orders are processed same day except weekends, with free shipping across Australia for purchases over $120. International shipping is available at competitive rates, with delivery times varying by location. Full payment is required at the time of purchase, with no additional hidden fees.
All our products are 100% vegan, cruelty-free, and made in Australia with sustainably sourced ingredients. We’re proud to be a certified organic brand, ensuring that what you put on your skin is free from harmful chemicals, parabens, and synthetic fragrances. Additionally, Mud Organics is committed to eco-friendly packaging, striving to reduce our environmental footprint in every way possible.

Welcome to Mudganics! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers. Affiliates may not use Keywords ‘Mud Organics’, ‘Sea Buckthorn Serum’ or ‘Mud Serum’ on any paid advertising platforms.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.


Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out or retracted from the next payout.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels. Affiliates may only use material created and shared by Mud Organics, any other materials need to be pre-approved by management.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.


To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.
If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

7. Prohibition of False Claims

Affiliates are prohibited from making false, misleading, or exaggerated claims about Mudganics products or services. All promotional content must be factual, honest, and in alignment with the information provided by Mudganics. Affiliates must not make unverified health or wellness claims or misrepresent the efficacy of products. 

Any affiliate found to be in breach of this condition will be immediately removed from the affiliate program, and any pending commissions may be withheld. Mudganics reserves the right to take legal action if necessary.

8. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: mud@mudorganics.com.au.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to mud@mudorganics.com.au for support.
